items.text: Cleveland S Grant Delpit (concussion), C Elgton Jenkins (knee), G Teven Jenkins (back), LB Carson Schwesinger (ankle) and DTs Mike Hall Jr. and Kalia Davis did not practice Wednesday. RBs Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson were limited and Todd Monken is optimistic both play. Deshaun Watson is not on the report.
Tennessee WR Calvin Ridley (hip) and S Tony Adams were limited Wednesday; Cam Ward is not on the report.
